The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean over the full pool may reduce influence of outliers and correlated errors.
Try a robust DBA combination on the full pool to see if iterative refinement beats the best per‑horizon weighting.
Try a forward‑selection based weighting on the full pool to capture complementary strengths without a fixed weight scheme (ranking unstable, many groups).
The series has a strong trend but unstable ranking; adding a simple inverse-error weighting on the compact, diverse pool4 may improve robustness by giving more weight to the few stable models.
The series is trend_dominated with unstable ranking; a robust DBA on the smaller pool may outperform the weighted combo.
ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a robust weighted combo over the full pool may still improve with a different weight scheme that balances variance.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9414. Series context: trend strength 0.9294 and seasonal strength 0.3964; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.111); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.495.
